title: Three-tradition passage reading: wording, versions and transmission
question: When three passages are read side by side, which textual, attribution and later-interpretive layers remain visible?
disclaimer: This is neither a claim that the three passages express one proposition nor a collation of variants within one text; each column returns to its own text, version, locator and transmission evidence.

readings.title: A Dao that can be spoken

text.title: Daodejing
text.summary: The formation, compilation and attribution of the Daodejing have several historical layers, and later Daoist and philosophical traditions repeatedly reinterpreted it.

passage.title: A Dao that can be spoken
passage.originalText: 道可道，非常道；名可名，非常名。
passage.punctuatedText: 道可道，非常道；名可名，非常名。
passage.modernZh: 能够说出的道，不是恒常的道；能够命名的名，不是恒常的名。
passage.translationEn: A Dao that can be spoken is not the constant Dao; a name that can be named is not the constant name.
